thread:
Morgan: FYI seeing a weird pattern in ap-south1: lots of tiny pods re-scheduling after short node NotReady blips. Evictions up ~3.8x over 30m.
Kevin: Any volume/attach errors in the events?
Morgan: events show repetitive attach timeouts: `FailedAttachVolume ... rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded` and `NodeNotReady` flaps immediately prior.
Anya: Kubelet logs report `attach timeout` and transient `NetworkUnavailable` right before the taint. Looks like host attach/network path flakiness.
Jessica: This churn is costing us. Early estimate: ~8% uplift in GPU-hours on that pool over 3h.
Ops-automation-bot: I can apply a scoped scheduler softening for a single nodepool to reduce scattering: propose nodeFlipGrace=30s and preemptScoreScale=0.5.
Kevin: Before changing scheduler globally, let's try a narrower canary: bump kubelet attachTimeout to 40s on warmpool-canary-01 and enable delayed-taint-lift so short blips don't trigger immediate eviction.
Anya: Agree. Also reduce preferSpreadThreshold for tiny pods on that nodepool to encourage coalescing when capacity is constrained.
Morgan: Plan: 1) patch kubelet config for canary, 2) apply scheduler softening scoped to canary, 3) monitor evictions, packing index, and cost for 20m, 4) rollback if bad, roll out if improved.
Ops-automation-bot: Patching warmpool-canary-01 kubelet config now: `kubectl patch cm warmpool-canary-kubelet -n infra --patch '{"data":{"attachTimeout":"40s"}}'`
Sre-bot: Alert: evictions-high firing for cluster/ap-south1 (4m).
Morgan: Canary shows evictions down ~60% after 9m. Packing index increased (more co-located tiny pods).
Jessica: If stable, expand canary to another nodepool and open infra ticket to investigate NIC driver/firmware and attach stack. Also add a scheduler CI test to simulate 10-20s NotReady flaps so we don't immediately binpack small pods.
Kevin: Applying temporary scheduler config to canary now. Ops automation will auto-revert in 2h unless promoted.
Anya: Adding follow-up: collect host kernel, NIC firmware and cloud provider attach metrics for the affected nodes.
Jessica: Add cost tracking to the follow-up runbook.
Ops-automation-bot: Temporary scheduler config applied (canary).
Sre-bot: Alert: evictions-high cleared for cluster/ap-south1 (now resolved in canary).
